policy: Actual source reading of eight locked train-only whole abstracts. Reuse44 computational TASK scope, flat contiguous BIO and named DATASET rules. Contiguous coordinated computational goals are retained as compound TASKs as in44; never reconstruct disconnected method or dataset names. Named models absent from abstracts are not copied from titles. URLs, unnamed datasets and Wikipedia/Wikidata provenance excluded. No relations judged in this NER-only experiment: every eligible candidate remains UNRESOLVED, never negative. AI initial labels and same-session review are not independent human gold.

documents.notes: NLP tasks/downstream scientific NLP tasks are unnamed task umbrellas. The suite's datasets and publication corpus are unnamed; no named DATASET invented. All repeated standalone method names retained, URL excluded.

TASK: predict the entire content of the masked span

Retain partial candidate spans but exclude the whole abstract from flat complete-NER training rather than silently drop the second benchmark or invent an expanded literal.
documents.notes: Do not erase this quarantine to increase named benchmark support. BERT-large is a distinct full model-version span; no nested BERT mention.

METHOD: propagating span representations via predicted coreference links

capturing relationships among entities in the same or adjacent sentences

documents.notes: Retain explicit object-qualified computational operations and contiguous compound operations, not reconstructed atomic names. Four datasets are unnamed. The multi-task framework is explicitly named DyGIE++; do not add an invented method named framework.

search over all spans in the sentence

documents.notes: Joint entity and relation extraction is one source-contiguous computational goal, not two invented entities. Longest flat source spans prevail. Generic light-weight reasoning does not name a separate technical family; datasets are unnamed.

fusing entity information early in the relation model

The contiguous composite extraction task is retained, not split into a nonliteral entity extraction name.
